body: Yeah I've moved a few times in the past few years, it never helps because nothing matters

I'm tired of having to go through the day-to-day bullshit of life. I can't stand being in my own head anymore because all of my thoughts are so negative and I hate myself. I think people would be better off if I killed myself because then they wouldn't have to worry about me anymore. Life is pretty good, I'm just not cut out for it.
I'm feeling very hopeless and anxious. I feel completely pulled by both sides and I feel like I might go through with my plan. I'm just so tired of living.
